description: This file defines classes, enums, and structures related to HARQ (Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest) processes management in a 5G NR scheduler, including HARQ process states, modes, and handling for both downlink and uplink, as well as a manager class for all HARQ processes within a cell.

classes.name: harq_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying HARQ process timeouts, with methods for general and feedback-disabled HARQ timeouts.

classes.name: harq_utils::harq_state_t
classes.description: Enumeration of possible HARQ process states: empty, pending retransmission, waiting for acknowledgment.

classes.name: harq_utils::harq_mode_t
classes.description: Enumeration of HARQ operation modes: normal and feedback-disabled or mode B.

classes.name: harq_utils::base_harq_process
classes.description: Base class for HARQ processes containing common parameters such as UE index, RNTI, HARQ ID, status, mode, and timing slots.

classes.name: harq_utils::dl_harq_process_impl
classes.description: Structure for downlink HARQ process parameters, including last transmission info, MCS, CQI, and slice ID.

classes.name: harq_utils::ul_harq_process_impl
classes.description: Structure for uplink HARQ process parameters, including last transmission info, MCS, and slice ID.

classes.name: harq_utils::cell_harq_repository
classes.description: Template class managing HARQ processes for either DL or UL, including allocation, deallocation, and timeout handling.

classes.name: ocudu::cell_harq_manager
classes.description: Main class managing all HARQ processes in a cell, including adding UEs, handling slot indications, and managing DL/UL HARQ processes.

classes.name: ocudu::unique_ue_harq_entity
classes.description: Class managing a set of HARQ processes for a single UE, including reconfiguration, reset, and HARQ process access.

classes.name: dl_harq_alloc_context
classes.description: Context information for downlink HARQ allocation during scheduling.

classes.name: ul_harq_alloc_context
classes.description: Context information for uplink HARQ allocation during scheduling.

classes.name: dl_harq_process_handle
classes.description: Interface for accessing and updating a specific DL HARQ process, including ACK handling and grant parameter storage.

classes.name: ul_harq_process_handle
classes.description: Interface for accessing and updating a specific UL HARQ process, including CRC info and grant parameter storage.

methods.name: harq_timeout_notifier::~harq_timeout_notifier
methods.description: Destructor for the HARQ timeout notifier interface.

methods.name: harq_utils::base_harq_process::cancel_retxs
methods.description: Method to cancel retransmissions for a HARQ process.

methods.name: harq_utils::base_harq_process::reset
methods.description: Method to reset a HARQ process.

methods.name: ocudu::cell_harq_manager::add_ue
methods.description: Method to add a new UE HARQ entity with specified number of DL and UL HARQ processes.

methods.name: ocudu::cell_harq_manager::slot_indication
methods.description: Method to update HARQ processes based on a slot indication.

methods.name: ocudu::dl_harq_process_handle::dl_ack_info
methods.description: Method to update DL HARQ process state based on ACK/NACK info.

methods.name: ocudu::ul_harq_process_handle::ul_crc_info
methods.description: Method to update UL HARQ process state based on CRC feedback.
